research.title: Claude Code Design Mode: The Figma-Screenshot-to-React Loop, Honestly Assessed
research.whyTrending: The frontend-design plugin plus the in-app browser closes the design→code→verify loop inside the terminal: /frontend-design renders live HTML/CSS/JS from prose, accepts Figma screenshots as pixel references, and the browser lets Claude navigate, screenshot and annotate specific elements by appearance rather than DOM structure. The community workflow is stabilising around Design → Craft → A11y → Perf with /baseline-ui and /fixing-accessibility. Directly on-brand for a frontend blog and almost entirely covered by hype posts rather than real evaluations.
